hints.title: Pyramid Sum Calculation
hints.text: For a peak value mid at target_idx, values decrease by at most 1 on either side until reaching 1.

hints.title: Sum Function on Triangular Slopes
hints.text: Calculate the minimal sum required for a given peak value using arithmetic series formulas.

hints.title: Binary Range Convergence
hints.text: Binary search over candidate peak values in the range [1, max_sum] to find the maximum feasible peak.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
